title: Iron Man and the little robot.
lines: Tony Stark is a very clever inventor.
He lives in a big house by the sea, with lots and lots of windows.
Under his house he has a workshop.
There are computers, screens that light up and lots and lots of tools.
Tony makes the craziest inventions there.
And he has made one very special invention: a suit made of metal.
When Tony puts it on, he becomes Iron Man!
Then he can fly, with fire under his feet.
And in his hands there are lights that shine.
One day Tony is working on something new.
It's no bigger than a cat.
It has two round eyes that light up blue, two little arms and wheels instead of feet.
But he's still a bit clumsy.
He drives over the cat's tail.
You've still got a lot to learn, Bolt.
He learns to pick things up with his little arms.
He learns to drive around the table without bumping into it.
He learns to roll a little ball to the cat.
And he learns to bring a cup of coffee without spilling.
A map of the city appears on the screen.
A big crane has fallen over at the harbour.
A man is stuck in a little office, under the heavy iron beams.
Bolt, you stay here, says Iron Man.
He rolls outside, along the road, all the way to the harbour.
He lifts a big beam with his strong arms.
he calls to the man in the office.
But the door of the office is stuck.
And the gap between the beams is very small.
Bolt, what are you doing here?
But then Iron Man has an idea.
Bolt drives through the narrow gap.
He puts his little arm into the lock.
He's a bit dusty, but he's all right.
He pats Bolt on the head.
His eyes light up, all blue.
Iron Man picks Bolt up and holds him.
I did tell you to stay at home, but you saved someone.
Iron Man flies, and Bolt sits on his shoulder.
Bolt looks at the city below him, with all its lights.
At home Tony makes something for Bolt.
A little red and gold cap.
Now Bolt looks a bit like Iron Man.
You're a hero now too, says Tony.
Because do you know what I learned today?
You don't have to be big to help.
And he brings Tony a cup of coffee.
